About Bukola

A student with a voice for impact.

Bukola Ayeni is a Nigerian student, public speaker, youth advocate, writer and changemaker passionate about health, education, gender equality, youth leadership and meaningful community action. She studies Botany at the University of Abuja while building a growing portfolio across advocacy, volunteering, public speaking and creative work.

🎤 Public Speaking

Youth leadership, confidence, girl-child empowerment, SDGs, menstrual health, personal growth and advocacy.

🌍 Global Youth Work

Global ambassador roles and youth-focused opportunities connecting local action with wider development conversations.

✍🏽 Storytelling

Writing and content creation through colorwriter and colorbukee — stories, reflections, lifestyle and mindset.

Queens Unite Initiative

Empowering girls to learn, lead and believe in themselves.

Queens Unite is Bukola's youth-led initiative focused on girls and young women through conversations and community action around confidence, body image, menstrual health, mental health awareness, leadership and the rights of the girl child.

Current impact focus: Ending period poverty — connecting menstrual health education and practical support with the Sustainable Development Goals.
